notes.title: Update 01 - Extreme tapes unlocked / Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed issue causing the red tapes to not be unlocked.
- Fixed Blizzard monster from getting stuck on hatches.
- Fixed Menu UI issues.

Big thank you for all of the support, I'm blown away by the positive response. I'm very sorry if any of the above issues negatively affected your experience. Looking forward to seeing who can reach the alternate ending.

Charlie
